column1: # Characters the PDF build replaces before handing the docs to pdflatex.
# pdflatex only accepts the subset of UTF-8 its inputenc knows; anything else
# stops the build with "Unicode character X not set up for use with LaTeX".
# That is a ten-minute CI failure for one character in one table, so this file
# is the single source of truth for the mapping, read by two things:
#   flake.nix               nix run .#docs-pdf   — applies these substitutions
#   scripts/test-docs-glyphs.sh                  — fails in a second if a page
# Format: one substitution per line, GLYPH<TAB>REPLACEMENT. A replacement may
# be empty (delete the character) but the tab must still be there. Lines
# Keep the replacements ASCII: the whole point is to leave nothing pdflatex
# cannot set. Prefer something that reads correctly in print — a box-drawing
# character standing in for a tree branch is decoration, an arrow in prose is
